credit: Destatis GV-ISys 30.09.2026 and GV100AD class codes; dl-de/by-2-0. Statistics Canada Census 2021 CSD attributes, boundaries and 2025 register; Statistics Canada Open Licence (OGL-Canada). INEGI ITER 2020 and current locality catalogue; Términos de Libre Uso. Wikidata own-item statements: CC0. Modifications: selected existing same-entity type, type_local and level facts; no endorsement. Per-row evidence: .github/fixes-docs/ledgers/types_decamx_v5x.jsonl and sibling .sources.json.

methods.identity: Own literal official code and population-pass name/state/geometry checks, unchanged identity inputs since that pass, and exact v4 name/item/state/country/point continuity. No inferred successor identity. Unresolved changes receive reviewed decision_only classification events citing compact ledger SHA256.
methods.DE: Only remove old-type and count-period failures; own current AGS, scope, Land and municipality polygon must pass. County-link failures do not negate own municipality geometry/code: no county link changed. Depth from current GV Regierungsbezirk and Kreis tier, never from a missing county link.
methods.CA: Only validated population-pass CSD bindings or otherwise_binding admitted; all other scope failures held. Exact own single P3012, name, valid official polygon coverage, same 2021/2025 CSD class/name; invalid geometry held without repair. Existing established depth retained.
methods.MX: Own single P1976 and locality class required; all prior name/state/municipio/point/current-catalogue checks pass. AMBITO U/R supplies local class; cabecera is a role, not urban status. A legacy unit requires single own P3801, sole municipality P31, literal own and official names, current municipio polygon coverage, unchanged current code/count and literal v4 continuity; same-named seats never borrow this class.
methods.population: No populations changed; population-only temporal objections do not alter classification.
methods.archives: Original acquisition timestamps retained. Hash-verified archives reused from adjacent population passes; exact locators included once. No browser in this headless run; official dictionary fetch returned HTTP 403.
methods.compact: Only changed rows and holds with an official candidate binding appear here; all 1548 target rows appear in review.jsonl and CSV partitions. g is a candidate for held rows, never an admitted match; r records the failed checks.
